story.title: Unmatched Zelle transactions: 34.6% to 11.7%
story.result: Unmatched Zelle transactions fell from 34.6% to 11.7%, and Cash App merchant resolution reached about 90%.
how: Wrote Redshift SQL using regex extraction, CTEs, and waterfall count queries to read Venmo, Zelle, PayPal, and Cash App descriptions.

Checked every rule with Excel coverage formulas and lookalike tests, so new rules did not create false matches.

story.title: Forecast error cut to 6.7%
story.result: Forecast error (MAPE) fell to 6.7%, compared with a 9.9% baseline.
how: Built a champion/challenger setup in Python that backtests four time-series models on holdout data.
Added a 10,000-path Monte Carlo planning engine driven by live S&P 500 returns and FRED inflation data.

bullets.t: Cut unmatched Zelle transactions from 34.6% to 11.7% and lifted Cash App merchant resolution to about 90% by writing Redshift SQL (regex extraction, CTEs, waterfall count queries) for Venmo, Zelle, PayPal, and Cash App descriptions, plus regex mapping rules for T-Mobile, AES, Southern California Edison, and Xcel Energy. Validated with Excel coverage formulas and lookalike checks to prevent false positives.

Evaluated an AI merchant-naming prompt against Finicity names using Excel models (COUNTIFS, match-status formulas) and root-cause analysis. A/B tested revisions, measured run-to-run variance, and caught a rule change that lowered accuracy before it was adopted.

Validated matching and reporting logic using test cases and mock transaction datasets in SQL and Excel (SUMIFS, period-over-period comparisons), reconciled outputs to expected results, and escalated defects, including a regex error, to protect data accuracy.

Ran quantitative and time-series analysis in R on multi-year transportation and commodity datasets, uncovering lead-lag relationships between rail flow patterns and corn and wheat basis spreads that informed pricing-strategy adjustments.

Designed forecasting frameworks using regression-based financial modeling, lead-lag analysis, SHAP analysis, and walk-forward validation, producing more reliable commodity-basis forecasts for pricing decisions.
Wrote analytical reports that translated transportation, logistics, and commodity market data into recommendations on supply-demand conditions, market trends, and operational performance.

Cut procurement costs by 12% by modeling vendor quotes against acquisition, logistics, and resale pricing assumptions in SQL and Excel, giving the team a cost comparison to anchor supplier negotiations.

Raised gross profit by 8% by testing markup thresholds and resale margins against purchase price and transportation costs, setting profitable pricing ranges and recommending the procurement and pricing decisions that followed.
Built Power BI dashboards tracking purchase trends, vendor performance, and cost variance, giving finance leadership one view of procurement performance and cost drivers.
Performed budgeting and cost analysis for industrial compressor procurement, comparing budget to actuals to flag cost variances early and support forecasting and sourcing decisions.

projects.name: FinScope: Personal FP&A and Market Analytics Platform

bullets.t: Built and deployed a full-stack FP&A web platform that automates budget vs. actuals variance analysis with auto-generated driver commentary, three-statement reporting, and one-click formatted Excel variance reports. A SQL transaction pipeline sits behind it with 98% rule-based categorization accuracy.

Implemented champion/challenger forecasting in Python, backtesting four time-series models on holdout data to reduce MAPE to 6.7% versus a 9.9% baseline. Engineered a 10,000-path Monte Carlo planning engine driven by live S&P 500 returns and FRED inflation data.

Integrated the SEC EDGAR API to analyze real 10-Q and 10-K filings for any US public company, resolving XBRL tag inconsistencies and deriving Q4 from fiscal-year totals. Shipped with 17 pytest tests and GitHub Actions CI.

projects.name: Credit Card Debt Risk and Consumer Behavior Analytics

bullets.t: Applied statistical modeling and machine learning in Python (pandas, scikit-learn) and SQL, using feature engineering and model evaluation to identify elevated-risk debt accumulation patterns and the drivers of consumer overspending.

Used segmentation analysis to find that the 30–40 age group is the most debt-prone, and distilled the psychological factors behind credit card usage and repayment to inform targeted financial interventions.
